_hinweis: Texts on the topic of the dressing room. egoist_auf_der_bank: the captain writes to the manager (“Gaffer”, formal). Placeholders: {spieler}, {spieler_kurz}.

standard: {spieler_kurz} is causing unrest in the dressing room
Gaffer, {spieler_kurz} is on the bench and making sure everyone feels it. He's slagging off the line-up in the dressing room. Hardly anyone is listening yet, but it shouldn't carry on like this.
Gaffer, just between us: {spieler_kurz} can't cope with the bench. In training he does his own thing, and after the game he's the first one out. The lads notice.
I'll speak to him myself and tell him what he has to do to make the starting XI.
Sort it out among yourselves. You have my trust in the dressing room.
Anyone who stirs up trouble trains with the second group for now.
Good, gaffer. If he hears it from you, he'll take it on board more readily. I'll keep the dressing room calm in the meantime.
All right, I'll have a word with him. I can't promise you he'll listen to me, though.
Understood. That's a clear sign to everyone. Expect him not to take it quietly, though.
